rationale: Setup at ss 100C max-RC is the only binding limit: hold >= +0.07 ns, final DRC 0, slew/cap <= 33 vs bar 309. At 7.02 ns all four round runs are port-path-limited (slack +0.63-0.70), with reg-to-reg ~6.10-6.17 ns at any utilisation 20-49. Port T_eff shrinks with the target (IO delays scale), so keep period_frac at the 0.45 floor. Round 2 (PL margin 0.4, slew 40%) gave the best runs (6.317, 6.354). Keep AREA 3, cap213, both margins at 0.4 and post-GRT timing repair (TPE's history would turn it off). Drop the PL_TIMING_DRIVEN pin (TPE already picks true from the top runs) and use it for the last repair lever not yet at its maximum: cap margin 40%.
